name: Relaxed Sphere Tracing
definition: A sphere tracing variant that scales up the SDF estimate value to take larger steps, improving performance. It reverts to the basic step size if the unbounding spheres of two consecutive steps are disjoint to prevent skipping intersections.
summary: Relaxed sphere tracing accelerates distance-field ray marching by scaling step sizes with a relaxation factor, distinguishing itself from enhanced tracing through simpler geometric assumptions.
